newsitem.title: USA: W.R. Grace completes spinoff, combination.
newsitem.headline: W.R. Grace completes spinoff, combination.

text.p: W.R. Grace & Co said Monday it has completed the spinoff to its common shareholders of a new company comprising its packaging and specialty chemicals businesses, and the combination of its former health-care subsidiary, National Medical Care Inc, with the worldwide dialysis business of Fresenius AG.
Grace said that prior to completion of the deal, it received a cash distribution of about $2.3 billion from National Medical Care.
Grace common shareholders are to receive 44.8 percent of the newly created health-care company, named Fresenius Medical Care AG FMS.N and 100 percent of the new W.R. Grace & Co.

For each Grace common share outstanding at the close of business on September 27, Grace shareholders are receiving one share of new Grace common stock, one share of a new class of preferred stock which may pay a special dividend based on the cash flow of Fresenius Medical Care, and 1.04909 American depository shares -- each representing a third of an ordinary share of Fresenius Medical Care.

Since September 17, new Grace common shares and Fresenius Medical Care shares have been traded on a "when-issued" basis. Grace said it has been informed by the New York Stock Exchange that it expects to resume regular-way trading "shortly" for both securities.
Fresenius said in a separate press release that regular-way trading in Fresenius Medical is expected to begin October 1.
